subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The keys have been forgotten by Jyoti.

options.text: Jyotii will have forgotten the keys.
Jyoti has been forgetting the keys.

solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'Jyoti has forgotten the keys.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice. We have to change the sentence into the active form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'present perfect' form. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Passive Voice: Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject
 
• Active Voice: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Passive voice: A letter has been written by Mohana.
 
• Active voice: Mohana has written a letter.
 
 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'The keys' and the subject of the given sentence is 'Jyoti.'
 
• So, in the active voice, the position of ‘object’ and ‘subject’ will be interchanged and 'by' will be removed. 
 
• Also here, 'have been forgotten' will be changed into 'has forgotten.'

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Jyoti has forgotten the keys.*
